features.description: Triangular cat-like ears attached to the top sides of the head, featuring warm orange-peach outer fur matching the hair and pale cream inner fluff. Both sides stay present and symmetric in every generated view, at exactly the size and height drawn.
features.label: Animal Ears

features.description: Short, voluminous warm ginger-orange hair cut into a wavy bob ending around the neck, with rounded curls at the tips, soft face-framing strands, and smooth parted front bangs layered across the forehead.
features.label: Wavy Short Bob with Bangs

features.description: A slender three-strand braid woven down the character's left side (viewer's right) beneath the cat ear, blending into the curled side locks.
features.label: Side Braid

features.description: Large, round anime-style eyes with vivid emerald-to-lime green irises, detailed circular highlights, dark upper lash lines with delicate corner lashes, and gentle thin brown eyebrows. Both eyes must be generated as an equal, mirrored pair sitting at exactly the same height with the same size and shape.
features.label: Emerald Green Eyes

features.description: Soft and friendly closed-mouth smile paired with an open, pleasant, and calm facial expression.
features.label: Gentle Smile

features.description: A faceted three-dimensional yellow star-shaped hair clip pinned on the character's upper right side (viewer's left) just above the temple.
features.label: Yellow Star Hair Clip

features.description: A small faceted light green star-shaped clip fastened near the lower end of the side braid on the character's left (viewer's right).
features.label: Green Star Braid Clip

sections.text: The eyes are a mirrored pair of large, rounded anime eyes. The irises feature a dark teal top that blends into emerald and vibrant yellow-green at the bottom with layered concentric curved patterns and dark pupils. Highlights consist of a prominent round white circle near the top center, two smaller round white dots along the lower corners, and faint tiny specks; they are framed by thick dark brown upper lash lines with an outer spike, fine lower lashes, and a subtle reddish-brown eyelid crease.
The eyebrows are thin, smoothly arched reddish-brown lines positioned above the eyes and partially visible beneath the bangs.
The mouth is closed in a gentle, subtle smile marked by a thin curved line, with no visible teeth or fangs.
The skin is a smooth, fair pale-peach tone with faint soft blush on the cheeks and a tiny dot defining the tip of the nose.

The hair is a bright warm-orange chin-length bob with full, layered bangs tapering across the forehead to the brows, textured wavy layers, and flared, curled tips around the sides and back. A single vertical three-strand braid runs down the hair on the viewer's right from near the ear to the chin.
A pair of upright triangular animal ears sits atop the head, covered in orange fur on the back and outer rim with plush white fur inside.
A faceted five-pointed yellow-gold star clip is pinned in the hair on the viewer's left, and a smaller faceted green star bead is attached at the bottom of the braid on the viewer's right.
